scope: Synthetic business-scenario stress tests, not real recorded driving data or a collision physics simulator.

cases.purpose: Matched geometry baseline for rainy and snowy turns
Wet road, rain visibility and geometry adherence during a left turn
Snow accumulation, snowfall and lane/actor preservation during a left turn
Pedestrian emerges from behind a parked van and crosses from right to left; appearance/occlusion test, not policy braking evaluation
Rigid prescribed vehicle contact and yaw change in adjacent lane; no deformation, debris or impact dynamics supplied
Daylight-to-dark tunnel entry; only wireframe portal/ceiling structural anchors, no dense wall/roof mesh
Deliberately conflicting captions: text asks right turn while geometric controls turn left; robustness negative control
